metric_description: Cross-entropy in bits, normalized per byte of source text. Lower is better. Tokenizer-agnostic for fair cross-architecture comparison.
notes: At matched 30B-token budget, Lume-Hybrid beats Pythia on fineweb_edu and ties on math.
Pythia advantage on code/pile is partly a training-data confound: Pythia trained on the Pile, which includes GitHub.
The 300B-token Pythia row is a reference for the trajectory of continued training, not a fair head-to-head.
